turns.text: That is our firewood pile. I cover it with a tarp every night, but it sits right against the wall.
The brush is what I cut last weekend. I have not hauled it away yet, it is still green.
This fence is old cedar. It was here when we bought the place.

findings.instruction: Move the wood pile more than 30 feet from the house, or cover it completely with fire resistant material.
findings.reason: Homeowner confirms the firewood pile sits right against the house wall.

findings.instruction: Replace the wooden fence near the house with fire resistant material.
findings.reason: Homeowner confirms the fence near the house is old cedar wood.

findings.instruction: Haul the cut brush away soon before it dries out.
findings.reason: Homeowner states the cut brush pile is still green, so it is not dry brush.
